name: app-tilted-yellow-process-card-listing-research-methods
title: Tilted yellow rounded card listing research methods on a white field
whatItIs: A wide white canvas with one tilted amber rounded card at the left carrying the word Research and a scattered list: Data Analysis, Problem Statement, User Journey, User Interviews and User Persona.
whatItMeans: Playful and light; the tilted card feels like a sticky note waiting for companions.
techniques: Tilt a coloured card to break a rigid grid.
Set list items in two loose columns in white on yellow.
Leave big white space for other cards to arrive.
Use the frame as one step of an animated sequence.

vocabulary.definition: A card rotated slightly for informality.
A list of activities in a process.
White space reserved for future elements.
One still from a motion piece.
